# `ceangal.editor`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_api_docs.py from ceangal/src/editor.almd; do not edit. -->

_A multi-line text editor view._

The code editor widget (also the single-line text field).

State is a plain record the app owns; the widget reads it through `get`
and writes it through `set`, so two events arriving before the next frame
both see the latest state:

  var doc = editor.from_string(source)
  editor.view("main", () => doc, (e) => { doc = e })

Text is kept as one codepoint list per line. Only visible lines are lexed,
shaped and drawn, so cost per frame does not grow with document length.

```almide
import ceangal.editor
```

```almide
type Pos = { line: Int, col: Int }
```

### `Diag`

```almide
type Diag = { line: Int, col: Int, end_line: Int, end_col: Int, severity: Int, message: String }
```

A diagnostic range: severity 0 error, 1 warning, 2 info.

```almide
type Snap = { lines: List[List[Int]], cur: Pos, anchor: Pos }
```

### `Editor`

```almide
type Editor = {
  lines: List[List[Int]],
  cur: Pos,
  anchor: Pos,
  want_x: Float,
  scroll_x: Float,
  scroll_y: Float,
  view_w: Float,
  view_h: Float,
  preedit: List[Int],
  preedit_cursor: Int,
  undo: List[Snap],
  redo: List[Snap],
  coalesce: Int,          // kind of the last edit (1 typing, 2 deleting), for undo grouping
  version: Int,           // bumps on every text change
  diags: List[Diag],
  font_size: Float,
  single_line: Bool,
  read_only: Bool,
  syntax: Bool,
  placeholder: String,
  scroll_to_cursor: Bool,
  line_style: List[Int],  // per-line color index into Theme.styles (plain text only)
  gutter: Bool,
  secret: Bool,           // shows • per character; copy / cut / a11y value are withheld
  touch: Touch,           // the finger on the view, if any
  fling_v: Float,         // momentum after a touch scroll (px/ms, + = down); 0 = none
  fling_t: Float,         // when the momentum was last advanced (ms)
  wrap: Bool,             // soft-wrap long lines at the view's width
  rows: List[Int],        // wrap cache: first visual row of each line, then the total
  rows_ver: Int,          // ... for this version
  rows_w: Float,          // ... and this wrap width
  align_end: Bool,        // right-to-left lines start at the right edge
}
```

### `Touch`

```almide
type Touch = { id: Int, x0: Float, y0: Float, sx0: Float, sy0: Float, t0: Float, mode: Int, ly: Float, lt: Float, v: Float }
```

A touch gesture: pending until it moves (scroll) or is held first (select);
a touch that ends without moving is a tap.

## Input

### `key`

```almide
pub fn key(e: Editor, phase: Int, code: Int, mods: Int) -> (Editor, Bool)
```

Key handling; returns (state, handled).

### `text`

```almide
pub fn text(e: Editor, kind: Int, s: String, cursor: Int) -> Editor
```

Text input: kind 0 commit, 1 IME preedit (shown at the caret, not yet
text), 2 preedit end, 3 paste; `cursor` is the preedit's caret (bytes).

### `pointer`

```almide
pub fn pointer(e: Editor, p: v.Pointer) -> Editor
```

Mouse: press places the cursor, drag extends the selection (shift+click
extends too). Touch (pointer id >= 1): drag scrolls with momentum, a tap
places the cursor, press-and-hold then drag selects.

### `wheel`

```almide
pub fn wheel(e: Editor, dx: Float, dy: Float) -> Editor
```

Wheel / trackpad: the dominant axis wins, so a vertical swipe does not
drift sideways (and the reverse).

### `keep_paint`

```almide
let keep_paint
```

Functions called only from the view's closures are listed here so they are
reachability roots: otherwise the wasm leg can drop them from its function
table when `view` is called from a named fn of the app (almide/almide#3296).
